subject: mushroom
name: 蘑菇
label: 两朵林间蘑菇
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. A distinctive pair of woodland mushrooms, one tall tilted cap and one short round cap, subtle curved gill divisions below the tall cap, no tiny texture.
Clean black contour drawing with large blank interiors. No dense repeated texture, no hatching, no shading or gray tonal fills. Keep the complete silhouette within the canvas with clear margins.
